summary: Grounding pass on the ICP council deliberation. Ran 7 Perplexity research queries covering S&C coach platform usage, LinkedIn ghostwriting market size ($50-100M, 5,000-10,000 providers), B2B founder buying behavior, coaching industry data ($5.34B global, 122,974 coaches), cold outreach conversion rates (10.3% reply, 0.5% close), coach social media usage, and competitor landscape (Media Engine, NUOPTIMA, Atticus, Cleverly etc.). Found 5 fabricated/wrong claims, 5 needing correction, 4 grounded. Surfaced a third ICP option: executive/leadership/business coaches who are LinkedIn-native, high-paying, and where Farrice's coaching psychology expertise is an actual moat vs. a generic differentiator.
